# Yaratu / Ярату

RU+EN product range with disclosed ingredients. Nutrition is calculated, not laboratory-tested. Halal is product-specific; no halal claim is made for Mramornaya.

- [Ветчина филейная](https://yaratu.com/products/vetchina/) / [Chicken fillet ham](https://yaratu.com/en/products/vetchina/)
- [Колбаса варёно-копчёная «Мраморная»](https://yaratu.com/products/mramornaya/) / [Mramornaya cooked smoked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/mramornaya/)
- [Сосиски с брокколи](https://yaratu.com/products/brokkoli/) / [Sausages with broccoli](https://yaratu.com/en/products/brokkoli/)
- [Сосиски «Молочные»](https://yaratu.com/products/molochnye/) / [Molochnye milk sausages](https://yaratu.com/en/products/molochnye/)
- [Колбаса варёная «Сливочная»](https://yaratu.com/products/slivochnaya/) / [Slivochnaya cooked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/slivochnaya/)
